column2: WARNING HVDC Filter Discharge Sign – Capacitors Can Retain Charge – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Capacitors Can Retain Charge. This WARNING HVDC Filter Discharge sign from CGAP Safety reads: HVDC FILTER DISCHARGE / CAPACITORS CAN RETAIN CHARGE / VERIFY DISCHARGE AND GROUNDING / BEFORE FILTER BANK ACCESS. Written for HVDC converter stations, transmission operators.

Why this sign matters

Filter capacitors keep a dangerous charge after the converter is shut down. Entering before the bank is discharged and grounded exposes a person to shock.

Where to post it

Mount on the filter bank fence gate and at the entry door of each capacitor enclosure.

Who orders it

Converter station electricians.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: NFPA 70E; ANSI Z535.4. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.

column2: WARNING Generator Bearing Jack Sign – Jack Pressure Loss Can Lower Rotor – 8x12 Aluminum

Why this sign matters

The rotor rides on jacking oil during bearing work. If oil pressure is lost the rotor settles onto the bearing and traps hands and tools.

Post on the generator pedestal beside the jacking oil manifold where the mechanic opens the bearing.

Turbine mechanics.
